description: System + field power input monitor ioThinx 45MR slot module. Addresses are module-relative; actual PDU address = slot_base + relative_address. FC03: spStatus (rel 0, system power status WORD), spLowerLimitValue (rel 1-2, f32 lower alarm threshold), spUpperLimitValue (rel 3-4, f32 upper alarm threshold), fpStatus (rel 5, field power status WORD). Write spLowerLimitValue/spUpperLimitValue to configure system power alarm thresholds.
